description: One step of an agent plan: what the agent intends to do, its live execution state and the timestamps the plan turns into durations. The record is a VALUE — a host composes the plan, hands it to TmAgentPlan and replaces a step with `step with { … }` when the run moves on. Timestamps are the only source of a duration: Duration needs both ends, and a Running step elapses from StartedAt to the "now" the caller passes (the plan reads it from its injected TimeProvider), never to the wall clock.
usageExample:
var step = new AgentPlanStep("Draft the outline", "step-1") { Status = AgentStepStatus.Running, StartedAt = TimeProvider.System.GetUtcNow() };
var done = step with { Status = AgentStepStatus.Done, CompletedAt = TimeProvider.System.GetUtcNow() };
